reason: My renderer is gone and I do need someone, and a free build of one of my own plans with nothing owed unless I like it is hard to say no to. I'd take the lunch, and if the walkthrough looks right I'd pay the $1,500.
objection: I'm in a truck all day and don't have time to chase another vendor. If the plans I hand over come back wrong, or it takes me three rounds at $500 each, it's more trouble than my old guy was.
would_change_my_mind: If the free sample came back wrong or ugly, or needed a lot of my time to fix, I'd drop it.
